Each ring is composed of multiple concentric circles that gently pulse and shift through a vibrant spectrum of jewel tones. The rings grow steadily outward while simultaneously throbbing with a rhythmic motion, creating an hypnotic, self-sustaining visual rhythm. The composition appears as a living field of expanding light and color, with each ring contributing to the overall dynamic complexity through subtle variations in speed, hue, and timing. The visual effect transforms simple geometric forms into an immersive, constantly evolving pattern that captures attention through its continuous motion and rich chromatic variation.
